name: agent-os
description: Shape better specs and keep coding agents aligned with your codebase's own standards.

interface.shortDescription: Agents that build the way you would
interface.longDescription: Agent OS discovers the conventions already in your codebase, writes them down as concise standards, and injects the relevant ones into whatever you are building. It also shapes specs before implementation, so plans start from your product context and your standards rather than from scratch.
defaultPrompt: Discover the coding standards in this codebase
Shape a spec for the feature I'm about to build
Inject the standards relevant to this task
